summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the single-file Ready2UP dashboard (/ready2up.html) via Playwright on the public preview URL. Covered: page load & root redirect, 40 lead cards, scoreboard stats, search/area/stage/pill filter composition, empty state, stage select + localStorage persistence + Deals Closed Today counter, stage filter interaction, sprint call tracker (increment/5th-call confetti/persistence/reset), all 4 per-card action links (wa.me, tel:, Find Phone new tab, Google Maps), pitch script modal (per-lead + generic playbook, copy buttons, close via X/Escape/backdrop), pricing packages, CSV export (name/rows/columns), confetti canvas, and mobile 390x844 dock/layout + desktop 1920 layout. 12 of 12 requested scenarios pass except one spec deviation on the modal WhatsApp Send button. Zero console/page errors on any flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec says the 'Send' button must be visible only when the lead has a phone number. Actual: openPlaybook() uses `send.hidden = !lead`, so it is visible for phone-less leads too (verified lead 2 Mykonos, phone=null -> button visible with href https://wa.me/?text=...). Functionally it still opens WhatsApp chooser, so severity is LOW, but it deviates from the stated requirement. Fix: `send.hidden = !(lead && lead.phone)`.

issues: Cuisine spec value is truncated with an ellipsis on multi-cuisine leads (e.g. 'North Indian, Asian, …', 'Multi-cuisine, Cockta…') with no title/tooltip attribute, so full cuisine text is unreachable on desktop. Consider adding a title attribute.
Toast renders directly above the bottom dock and long messages wrap to 2 lines partially overlapping the dock's top edge visually (readable, cosmetic only).
Button word spacing looks tight in headless screenshots ('PitchPlaybook', '+LogCall') - font/emoji fallback in headless Chromium, not a code defect.

action_items: Optional: hide wa-send-btn for leads without a phone (`send.hidden = !(lead && lead.phone)`) to match spec
Optional: add title attribute to truncated cuisine spec values
critical_code_review_comments: ready2up.html is 1688 lines in a single file - acceptable given the explicit single-file requirement, but data (40 leads) could be split if the constraint ever relaxes
State is localStorage-only with date-keyed reset (r2u_lead_stages_v1 / r2u_daily_calls_v1) - correctly guards legacy string stage values and stale dates
celebrate() guards `typeof confetti !== 'function'` - CDN loaded fine in sandbox (canvas element appeared on Deal Won / celebrate / 5th call)
seed_data_creation: None - static data. localStorage cleared before each test batch; stage for lead 2 reverted to New Lead and call counter reset after tests.
